overview_text: The data science and public health combined major offers students a strong foundation and experiential education integrating studies in public health and data science. The program covers the social determinants of health, biostatistics and epidemiology, health communication, and health education and program planning. Students have an opportunity to study the collection, manipulation, storage, retrieval, and computational analysis of data in its various forms, including numeric, textual, image, and video data from small to large volumes.
